new.note: Vanilla ice cream in chocolate-lined waffle cones, dipped in chocolate and chopped peanuts.
new.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate. Brush a little inside 4 waffle cones and dip the rims, then roll the rims in 50g chopped peanuts. Chill until set. Fill with scoops from 1L vanilla ice cream, drizzle over the rest of the chocolate and freeze until serving.

r2.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep frozen

steps.text: Melt the chocolate, brush a little inside the cones and dip the rims, then roll the rims in the peanuts.
Fill with scoops of ice cream, drizzle with the rest of the chocolate and freeze until serving.

new.note: Frothy milky coffee with a dusting of cocoa, worth every one of 37 dollars.
new.how: Brew 500ml strong coffee. Heat 600ml milk until steaming and froth it with a whisk or frother. Pour the coffee into 4 big mugs, top with the hot milk and foam, and dust with cocoa.

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming and froth it.
Pour the coffee into 4 big mugs, top with the milk and foam, and dust with cocoa.
